method: Independent manual, six-dimension conceptual rubric. Scores are ordinal judgments weighted by the prescribed rubric, not embedding measurements or plagiarism probabilities.
exclusions: Shared GSE273600 measurements, sample metadata and deposited processing facts
Established statistical formulas and general inverse-problem methods
Harbor canary, closing suffix, package layout and routine Python boilerplate

corpus.review_scope: Programmatic full-text screening of frozen main/lite instruction corpus and biology source code, direct reading of biologically or lexically closest instructions and their relevant scientific implementation sections; direct primary scientific source sections. Not every unrelated code file received equal-depth manual review.

rationale.output: Gene modules, pathways and metabolites are distinct from a sample bijection and aliquot support/residual tables.
rationale.evaluation: Source experimental mechanism evidence is distinct from planted technical provenance and independent numerical certificates.

conceptual_originality: PASS within reviewed scope: maximum substantive rubric overlap 25%, below the user threshold 30%. Established sample-integrity and mixture principles are prior art; no absolute novelty claim is made.

raw_similarity_investigation.method: Actual pinned checker, raw instructions, max_features=5000 unigram/bigram TF-IDF fitted on reference corpus (98 references including other task). Reference fitting is asymmetric. Initial corpus contained a duplicate staged reference; correction changed corpus only, not task wording.
raw_matches_investigated: Task 1 opening/data/estimand paragraphs versus Task 2 instruction:7,13-18: identical experiment, parental/Dmr-PERK, treatments, counts and TPM, Ensembl keys, fractional values, source floor, missing UT2 and ATF4 limitations.
Task 1 audit.json/interpretation.json versus Task 2 instruction:60-82: measured dataset audit and cautious biological claim flags.
The canary and final Harbor time/anti-cheating suffix are verbatim prescribed boilerplate.
substantive_differences: Task 1 compares 4-group treatment/line effects with Welch uncertainty, affirmative equivalence, minimum effects, joint-null BY adjustment and missing-control regions.

Task 2 identifies exact samples by nuisance-adjusted cross-representation fingerprints and reconstructs one/two-source technical aliquots with support optimality and open-set feature-holdout rejection.
raw_similarity_investigation.conclusion: Raw TF-IDF exceeds 30% and triggered this investigation. It is not hidden or redefined as an adjusted score. Direct section and scientific code inspection finds shared dataset/guardrail vocabulary and generic Python structure, without duplicated substantive objective or inference pipeline. No cosmetic wording changes were made. The upstream 80% static threshold and user 30% substantive threshold are distinct.

limitations: Finite-source review cannot prove absolute originality or exclude all prior literature.
Ordinal weighted scores are reviewer judgments, not semantic embeddings or measured percentages of copied intellectual content.
IDCheck review is limited to its primary abstract; no claim of a full implementation audit.
Failed/challenge-page retrievals in the manifest are not scientific content. Labbé BioC, GDF15 EuropePMC and voom fulltext fallbacks were used.

Generic AST node-type histograms largely reflect Python loops, calls, arrays and dictionaries; their approximately 99% values are non-discriminating for algorithmic copying. Low lexical overlap alone also cannot establish originality.
No external LLM QC or Gemini API was used.
